meta._doc: Coverage-closing pass: positions the confusable tokens the scorecard discovered in the tree but that no row yet claimed (guard-gate colorize/gatedscore/shortcount, plan cmdgodsplitplan/planstep, session-runtime setsessionfleetprovider/sessionsteer, context-ctx freshcontext, loop looporphan, render-materialize renderinfocacheablationrows). Each row is grounded on a real production identifier and draws an explicit line against its family siblings. Verdict 'defined' (distinction drawn, not yet glossary-anchored).

rows.definition: The cmd/fak function that layers ANSI TTY color onto an ALREADY-assembled, already-width-capped guard info block, preserving the exact display width (info_color.go).
rows.distinction: It only PAINTS an existing block and draws no admission decision - not a guard/gate adjudicator like acceptancegate, not guardInfoShortCount which FORMATS a single number, and not renderInfoCacheAblationRows which BUILDS the rows it later colors.

rows.definition: The internal/frontierswe function that applies anti-cheat zeroing on top of GatedScore: a trial flagged in scoring/anticheat.json scores 0 regardless of its raw gated value (score.go).
rows.distinction: It is the anti-cheat WRAPPER over GatedScore (the raw correctness x speedup gate), not GatedScore itself, and its 'gate' is a score penalty - not a git-hook gate or a pre-call guard adjudicator like acceptancegate/evaluateprocguard.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak helper that renders an integer compactly for a budget cell in the guard info panel (950 -> '950', larger values abbreviated) so a count fits its column.
rows.distinction: It is a display FORMATTER for one number in the guard panel, not a guard/gate that admits or refuses anything, and not colorizeGuardInfoBlock which colors the whole assembled block.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak thin shell over internal/godsplitplan: the read-only entrypoint that renders the god-file split plan a person runs from the CLI (godsplitplan.go).
rows.distinction: It is the CLI SHELL that prints a godsplit plan, not the plan data itself and not a runtime dispatchPlan or blockPlan - it decides nothing, it only projects the core's plan.

rows.definition: The internal/memq struct describing one explained stage of a memory query - what the op does and whether it is an estimate - the unit a recall EXPLAIN plan is built from (plan.go).
rows.distinction: It is one STAGE inside a memq explain plan, not the whole plan and not a dispatch/block plan; it is also NOT the identically-named glm52prefillsweep.PlanStep (a prefill request/land pair), a true homonym to keep separate.

rows.definition: The internal/gateway Server method that installs the pull source for the live cross-machine SessionFleet, the seam the fleet pane reads through (session_fleet.go).
rows.distinction: It is the INSTALLER/setter for the fleet provider, not the SessionFleet snapshot it yields and not a scheduler; it sits beside the sibling seams SetSessionEndpointsProvider / SetSessionHarnessProvider, each installing a different pull source.

rows.definition: The internal/sessionsteer package: the pure decision core of the zero-knob automatic-context doctrine that, given a content-free context-value snapshot, emits one typed directive the guard hooks turn into a SessionStart RULE and a Stop-hook PERSIST decision (epic #2198).
rows.distinction: It only DIRECTS the harness - it does not rotate context and is not the Session drive record nor the Scheduler; it sits below the relay rotation driver and hands the guard hooks a directive, not a mutation.

rows.definition: The internal/choicetriage Disposition value 'FRESH_CONTEXT': the default routing for an operator-directed note that is knowable but not obvious - evaluate it in a fresh sub-context rather than paging the current one (choicetriage.go).
rows.distinction: It is a triage DISPOSITION enum value that routes a decision to a fresh sub-context, not a stdlib context.Context and not a BaseContextPlan (a sysprompt assembly plan) - it names WHERE to answer, not the answer's plumbing.

rows.definition: The internal/looporphan package: the pure duplicate-loop-supervisor reaper core that folds a process census of loop/drainer SUPERVISORS into a closed keep/reap plan that never strands live work.
rows.distinction: It reaps duplicate SUPERVISOR processes via a keep/reap plan, not the loop runner itself and not the crashloop restart fence; the impure census and liveness probe live in the cmd/fak shell that hands this core plain data.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak function that projects the live CacheAttribution block into the Cache tab's TUI rows (info_cache_ablation.go).
rows.distinction: It BUILDS the cache-ablation rows from an attribution block, not a generic renderer and not colorizeGuardInfoBlock which only colors an already-assembled block downstream.
